title: Forever King
story:
A grandfather sat with his grandson under the evening sky.

The boy looked up at the stars.

“Who made all this?” he asked.

The grandfather smiled.

“My grandfather told me the same story when I was your age.”

“He said God made everything.”

The boy listened closely.

“Did his grandfather tell him too?”

“Yes,” the old man replied.

“For many generations.”

The boy thought for a moment.

“So God has always been there?”

The grandfather nodded.

“He was there before us.
He is with us now.
And He will be there after us.”

The boy looked at the stars again.

This time, he felt something different.

A sense of peace.

A sense of belonging.

In life, people come and go.

Generations rise and fall.

But God’s kingdom never ends.

His rule continues forever.

His promises remain true.

From one generation to another.

We can trust Him.

Not just for today.

But for all time.
life_lesson:
God’s kingdom is eternal, and His faithfulness continues through every generation.

You can trust Him always.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your everlasting kingdom.

Thank You for being faithful through every generation.

Help me to trust in Your promises.

Let my life reflect Your goodness to those around me.

And help me to pass on faith to the next generation.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you trust God not just for today, but for your future?

How can you pass your faith to the next generation?

What does God’s eternal kingdom mean to you personally?
verse:
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom.
And Your dominion endures through all generations.
